meta.description: MAVEX INVESTMENTS connects a Singapore commercial platform with tungsten- and molybdenum-material processing, recovery, and international trade in Laos.

hero.label: Tungsten · Molybdenum · Circular value
hero.title: From complex materials to strategic value.
hero.intro: A Singapore commercial platform and Laos industrial operations for tungsten- and molybdenum-material processing, recovery, product conversion, and international trade.
hero.imageNote: Facility imagery shown on this website is from the company's Laos operations.

company.label: Company platform
company.title: Commercial reach. Industrial depth.
company.intro: MAVEX INVESTMENTS PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-incorporated company active in industrial chemical wholesaling and strategic investment. Its regional operating footprint connects international trade with metal-material processing in Laos.
company.conceptAlt: Conceptual visualization connecting commercial logistics with strategic-metal processing
company.platformDescription: Based in Singapore, MAVEX supports international trading, strategic investment, and cross-border coordination across strategic-metal value chains.
company.capacityNote: Capacity figures indicate stated nameplate and production design, not actual annual output.

capabilities.title: Focused on tungsten and molybdenum value.
capabilities.intro: Current contract-processing scope covers tungsten- and molybdenum-bearing materials, with products including APT, ferrotungsten, and ferromolybdenum.
